name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: Dot Compliance is asking someone to take an agentic AI unit from zero to a real go-to-market motion, and that is the specific motion I run at Solenzo every day: turning a business's loosely defined intent into working AI agent logic, then building the narrative that gets a customer to trust it.

At Wix, I took a brand-new vertical from proof of concept to a profitable business line, building the enablement materials and sales training that helped a team sell something that did not exist a year earlier. I also work inside ChatGPT and Claude daily as production tools, not slide-deck talking points, which means I can translate technical AI capability into language a non-technical buyer can act on rather than just describe it secondhand.

Life sciences is new ground for me specifically, but building the story around a technical AI product for a buyer who needs to trust it before they adopt it is not. I'd welcome a conversation about how that experience applies to your agentic unit's launch. I'm available at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
